On 28th October - 1st November 2009 I attended and spoke at the graduation of participants of Wider Horizons programme in Pittsburgh, P.A., U.S.A. Also in receipt of General Expenditure Allowance/Staff Salary Costs: (January 2020) �26,000 (reflects salary costs for office staff for January 2020 and contractual redundancy payments for three members of staff reflecting their years served and payment in lieu of holidays not taken). Subsistence Allowance: �323 per day for six days in January 2020. Travel Reimbursements: �340. (Registered 6 February 2020)
